text: Replace categorical hour with a two-dimensional cyclic hour representation while retaining tab and weekday.
rationale: Hour-specific validation ranking varies substantially, with GAUC 0.51212 at hour 3 versus 0.65698 at hour 21. A cyclic representation shares statistical strength between adjacent hours instead of learning unrelated one-hot weights, potentially reducing sparse-context instability.
exact_ablation: Ablate only the categorical hour encoding and replace it with sin(2π·hour/24) and cos(2π·hour/24), keeping tab, weekday, user_id, video_id, additive scoring, BCE training, and every hyperparameter otherwise unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Small increase of approximately +0.0005 to +0.0025 from smoother temporal generalization, with risk of -0.0010 if hour effects are non-cyclic.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Small uncertain increase of approximately -0.0005 to +0.0025; smoother hour effects may improve top-five stability but reduce sharp useful distinctions.
